_comment: Clef (27B) Index on the pre-registered 2,008-row m1 DEV subset (jobs/common/dev_subset_m1.json): S0 env + 55 GB download (hf_cache false), S1 probes (parity, kernel_path, encodings; no gradient probe) + measured-rate preflight, S2 decide (live rate guard), S2c over-length sensitivity at max_length 32768 (rows of jobs/clef_baseline/overlength_rows.json in the subset), S2b native arm, S3 score (edition 0.2.1 as job-sgihj, plus a 0.3 report) / composite (headline) / ECE / latency / required paired compare vs Clef-flash job-sgihj. DEV only. Canary for the full job; its measured index rate re-derives the full job's caps (price.py rederive). Planning rate: the card's 5.39x Clef/Clef-flash latency ratio (index 17.1 + load 1.6).
no_verdict_reason: baseline measurement of a frozen external checkpoint (Clef 27B) on the Index DEV slice: numbers are reported with CIs, nothing is promoted or selected, so there is no verdict; stop conditions are in JOB_SPEC 4b
pricing: jobs/clef_baseline/price.py: job-sgihj measured Clef-flash rates; Clef planned at the card's 5.39x median-latency ratio (FLOPs ratio 3.52 is the optimistic reference)
